'''Pat Sullivan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Chantilly tournament]] on 10 March 2001 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|Scum with Pote as rep (generic MKOS)]] and [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC]], according to Gordon Marx's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1861">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-gordons-chantilly-tr-3-10-01d1861/ gordons-chantilly-tr-3-10-01], DeckTech (Gordon "Tallus" Marx, 11 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-gordons-chantilly-tr-3-10-01d1861/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
